Barkbare: Like grafting tree bark. Chance to steal armour strength from target on every attack.
Canopy's Blessing: The trees sing in your favour. Inflicts small amounts of Damage blocked by Armour to your foe.
Chamariz: A free spirit's allure. Creates a decoy on every Perfect Dodge that will keep enemy attention for a short time.
Conquerer: Each battle, a drop in the well of war. Restores a small amount of Life from enemies you fell.
Everbound: Power in unity. Maximum Life increased.
Fellust: Strike with the wrath of The Felling. Do more damage directly following a finisher.
Feral: Mother loves fiercely. Increases chance with each point spent.
Forestall: Cheat death once more. Gain a chance to survive where otherwise you would die.
Gravitate: Latch onto your target with Synsylk thread. Inflicts additional Voltaic Damage after kicking a foe.
Guiling Eye: Exploit every weakness. Inflicts Poison Damage to enemy weak points.
Healheart: Your heartbeat quickens. Reduces charge time for Runes by restoring Life.
Hungry Flame: The fire within burns ever brighter. Increases Weapon Damage when enemies' take Flame Damage.
Iridis' Favour: A pact under the green moon. Gain Spirit.
Last Stand: Hold your ground. Increases Attack Speed during low Life.
Lightning Strike: Pound the ground with meteoric force. Inflicts additional Voltaic Damage on downed foes.
Mora's Pride: A pact under the red sun. Gain Courage.
Olho por Olho: An eye for an eye. Increases the chance to cause bleeding Attacks by Dodging.
Physic: Survival graces the well-prepared. Increase the amount of Life Elixirs you can carry.
Pickpocket: By cunning sleight of hand. Grants ability to steal loot from unsuspecting foes.
Poacher's Gambit: Hunters be not hunted. Chance to become briefly invisible each time you are stuck by an enemy.
Righteous: Your rule is supreme. Regains Arcanic power to cast Behest more quickly.
Rooted: Grounded by pact, your defence against Stagger is heightened.
Saphene's Gift: A pact under the blue sun. Gain Grace.
Shrouded: Child of the shadow. Casts Spectral Sight so foes glow clearly in the dark.
Smolder: Targeted enemy heats up under your gaze. Increases Flame Damage.
Soulbound: Strength in numbers. Increases Melee Damage when an ally is in range, can stack.
Stalwart: Stand tall. Gain a chance to resist being knocked down.
Tendril: Alca defends her children. Casts creeping Tendrils that ensnare foes temporarily when they attack.
Vernal Pool: Water is life. Regains Arcanic powers quicker when standing in water.
Wingspan: When you fall, your Sparrow Soul has more time to return to your body.
